Invited to Generalist - Failed instantly.
I was recently invited to the generalist project at Outlier. I had spent a lot of time carefully writing answers that I know were correct. I am already very familiar with the tasks as I have been doing the exact same tasks for another annotation organization and I do this kind of work over 80 hours a week. I was instantly failed. There is no way that my submission was reviewed. I provided answers as per the guidelines and the answers were appropriate.

  
Is there no way to contact support? All I have seen so far is that once you're marked as failed, there is no second attempt.
